reviews.rationale: The packet meets the contract's ordinary-reading test: substantial AI-content volumes in web publishing and music, alongside documented abuse and harmful legal hallucinations within the target period. This supports cross-domain prevalence and real harm, without establishing that all measured AI content is slop or that every named domain is affected.
